title: A Multi-Model Collaborative AI Framework for Cross-Disciplinary Natural Science Research: The CAI Model Approach

contributions.purpose: 提出跨学科科研的多模型协作框架
contributions.mechanism: 9+1 双脑架构:M01-M09 并行发散探索,M10 仲裁融合,配 10x10 互补矩阵动态调度,均基于 GPT-5(MYGPT)实现
contributions.evaluation: 定性框架设计;三层结构+互补矩阵,声称 1-2 小时产出结构化科研方案
contributions.domain: AI 辅助跨学科科学研究框架
contributions.source_quote: This paper introduces the Cocktail AI Integration (CAI) Model, a structured 9+1 dual-brain architecture built on GPT-5 via MYGPT, combining human-curated innovation logic with automated reasoning.

contributions.purpose: 把仲裁式同行评审嵌入生成过程,区别于纯集成/多智能体
contributions.mechanism: M10 premier 模型对 M01-M09 输出做语义对齐、冲突消解与加权综合(principled arbitration 而非平均),实现系统内验证
contributions.evaluation: 定性;声称减少偏差、增强一致性与可复现性
contributions.source_quote: CAI enforces a cognitive separation between divergent hypothesis generation (M01-M09) and convergent synthesis (M10), enabling a peer-review-like process that is integrated directly into the reasoning workflow.

contributions.purpose: 用实验证明 CAI+M10 优于单模型与 SOTA 基线
contributions.mechanism: 3 个跨学科任务(科研流程重构/知识流建模/地震预测),由 5 个 LLM(GPT-5/Gemini/Copilot/Claude/Grok3)组成的 AI 评审面板按 novelty/feasibility/consistency 打分,并做 ANOVA+Tukey HSD
contributions.source_quote: Across all three tasks, CAI+M10 consistently achieved 10-20% higher novelty, 12-18% higher feasibility, and 25-30% higher consistency than baselines, with results statistically significant (p < 0.05).

self_declared_provenance.quote: Its architecture draws inspiration from ensemble learning, dual-brain cognitive science, and combination drug therapy in medicine, where multiple agents are combined to suppress different risk factors and enhance treatment effectiveness.

The dual-brain model proposed in previous work (Anonymous, 2025) showed strong potential. By orchestrating divergent exploration and convergent judgment across multiple models, it exceeded single-agent systems in novelty and feasibility scoring... However, it functioned primarily as a review mechanism detached from the generative workflow.
The CAI Model introduces an arbitration mechanism that draws inspiration from peer review, integrated within the reasoning process.

notes: 协议适配问题严重:名为实证框架文,实为观点/框架文披自证外衣。(1) 全部 evaluation 是 5 个 LLM 互评自打分(novelty/feasibility/consistency),无客观基准/ground truth,且被评方 CAI 本身也由 GPT-5 构成,评审面板与基线是同一批模型——自我评价循环。(2) 分数为可疑整数(98%/96%/97%),ANOVA/Tukey 由 AI 自行计算(Appendix I),无原始数据。(3) Test 2/Test 3 的推理输出被明确省略(line 945-948:'the detailed content is not included here... temporarily omitted'),仅 Test 1 有完整轨迹,却已报三任务统计显著性。(4) AI 自我披露(Appendix B AI Research Autonomy Disclosure):论文由自主 AI 系统(CAI)构思、结构化、撰写,人类仅做非生成性策展(排版/翻译/LaTeX);checklist 全 [D]=AI 主导。(5) AI 自承局限(Appendix J):originality/domain adaptation 受限、error propagation、premature adoption 风险、与人类优先级错配;代码与 per-model 手册未公开(Q5=No)。decision=reject。
